primaryOutcomes.description: Patients are graded according to their own symptoms（abdominal pain，bloating，defecation satisfaction，the extent to which the disease affects the lives of patients，bowel movements）, the total score less than 75 points was considered as in remission, 75\~175 as mild, 175\~300 as moderate, and over 300 as severe. We will assess changes in patient scores before and after treatment to reflect the extent of disease remission.
primaryOutcomes.measure: Irritable Bowel Syndrome Symptom Severity(IBS-SSS) scale
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: IBS-SSS was evaluated by patients at 4th week

primaryOutcomes.description: Different fecal types can reflect different intestinal transit times, the lower the score, the longer the transmission time; the higher the score, the shorter the transmission time. We will assess changes in scores before and after treatment to reflect the extent of disease remission.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: BSFS was evaluated by patients at 4th week

secondaryOutcomes.description: Grading from the field of physiology, independence, and psychology，Use score changes to assess improvement in all areas of the patient.Minimum score is 0，means no symptoms，maximum score is 144，means all symptoms are severe.
secondaryOutcomes.measure: IBS-D PRO( patient reported outcomes) Scale
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: IBS-D PRO Scale was evaluated at 4th week

secondaryOutcomes.description: Score evaluation from 8 aspects: physical function, role-physical, pain, global health status, vitality，social function,role-emotional， mental health.Use score changes to assess improvement in all areas of the patient. Maximum score is147.The higher the score, the better the status in all aspects.
secondaryOutcomes.measure: SF-36(the MOS item short from health survey)Scale
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: SF-36 Scale was evaluated at 4th week

identificationModule.briefTitle: GADD34 and Type I IFN Response Genes in SLE
identificationModule.officialTitle: Evaluation of GADD34 and Type I IFN Response Gene Expression in Patients Suffering From Systemic Lupus Erythematosus

primaryOutcomes.description: Evaluation of GADD34 expression in PBMC of patients suffering from SLE compared to GADD34 expression in PBMC of healthy subjets. GADD34 gene expression level is quantified in the PBMC by quantitative PCR

secondaryOutcomes.description: Evaluation of the relation between IFN response gene expression and GADD34 expression in PBMC of patients suffering from SLE. IFN response gene and GADD34 expression level is quantified in the PBMC by quantitative PCR
secondaryOutcomes.measure: GADD34 and IFN response gene expression

secondaryOutcomes.description: Evaluation of the relation between GADD34 overexpression and the activity of the pathology
Evaluation of the relation between GADD34 overexpression and the presence of anti-DNA antibodies.
Evaluation of the expression of other genes of UPR (like CHOP and BiP) in PBMC of patients with SLE, compared to the expression of these genes in PBMC of healthy subjets.
